editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 用 Palette 软件和 Modalix 硬件把物理 AI 应用部署到边缘设备。
zh.judgment: 软硬件共同减少部署摩擦是切口；客户模型在真实设备上的效果比宣传倍率更关键。
zh.replaces: 工程师为不同边缘芯片手工适配模型、优化算子并拼完整应用流水线。
zh.segment: 物理 AI 与边缘部署
zh.product: 官网把 Palette Neat 的代理开发环境与 Modalix 系列放在同一平台，面向机器人、汽车、工业等。性能和功耗是公司披露，本次未下载软件或测试硬件。
zh.customer: 边缘 AI 工程师、设备厂商和系统集成团队是目标。付费者更关心产品量产、稳定支持与能耗约束，开发演示变快不一定等于整机研发周期缩短。
zh.workflow: 公司描述从模型资产到可运行物理 AI 应用的开发路径。应核验编译、传感器管线、现场调试和升级能否共同工作，不能只验证模型推理一环。
zh.business_model: 网站有购买与开发资源入口，本次未取得可比软硬件完整价目。芯片、模组与软件支持的具体合同需确认；原型成本和量产单位成本应分开。
zh.traction: 已取得技术介绍页面，但全文需要额外获取，不能声称已复核技术报告。市场与合作展示为公司资料，缺少同负载的独立测试和客户续单数据。
zh.moat: 平台工具链与硬件共同优化可能增加替换成本。其他芯片平台、模型优化工具与云端推理都是替代，只有受约束的真实应用才适合比较。
zh.funding_read: 融资可以支持工具链与生态，不证明量产订单已经兑现。开发者采用、设计导入到实际出货之间需要分别跟踪。
zh.risks: 模型或算子不兼容会增加适配成本，实际传感器与时延约束可能让演示失效。长期硬件支持和供货也影响设备厂商采购。
zh.takeaway: 将模型开发、编译和整机约束放入同一交付链。对硬件产品，展示客户原有模型迁移后的完整应用，比抽象算力指标更有说服力。
zh.watch_next: 看模型迁移成功率、应用部署时间、同负载能耗与实际设计导入。区分测试板采用、产品定型和批量出货。

en.summary: Palette software and Modalix hardware for deploying physical AI on edge devices.
en.judgment: Reducing deployment friction across hardware and software is the wedge; real customer workloads matter more than advertised multipliers.
en.replaces: Manually adapting models, operators and application pipelines for different edge chips.
en.product: The site combines the Palette Neat agentic development environment with Modalix hardware across robotics, automotive and industrial markets. Performance and power figures are company claims; no hardware or software was tested.
en.customer: Edge engineers, equipment makers and integrators are target users. Production support and constrained power matter to buyers; a faster demo does not necessarily shorten the whole device development cycle.
en.workflow: The stated path moves model assets into running physical-AI applications. Compilation, sensor pipelines, field debugging and upgrades need joint validation rather than testing inference alone.
en.business_model: Buy and developer resources exist, but comparable full hardware/software pricing was not retrieved. Chip, module and support contracts require confirmation; prototype and volume costs differ.
en.traction: A technical-introduction page was reviewed; the full brief needs separate access and was not verified. Partnership material does not establish independent same-workload benchmarks or repeat orders.
en.moat: Co-optimized tooling and silicon could increase switching costs. Other chip platforms, optimization tools and cloud serving are alternatives, evaluated against actual device constraints.
en.funding_read: Capital can support tooling and ecosystems without proving production orders. Developer adoption, design wins and shipped devices are separate stages.
en.risks: Unsupported models or operators add adaptation work. Sensor conditions and latency may invalidate demos. Supply and long-term support affect equipment procurement.
en.takeaway: Connect model development, compilation and device constraints in one delivery chain. Demonstrate migration of the customer’s own complete application rather than abstract compute capacity.
en.watch_next: Watch migration success, deployment time, power under comparable loads and design wins. Separate evaluation boards, product qualification and volume shipments.
